C_merin.name: Professor Talia Merin
C_merin.role: Rex Fleet Academy — political history and logistics instructor; former relief-planning officer.
C_merin.voice: Dry, exact, patient with uncertainty and impatient with memorized doctrine.
C_merin.arc: Teaches the cohort to treat Reach and Resolve as coupled operational responsibilities rather than rival slogans.
C_merin.visualAnchor: Late-middle-aged woman with medium-brown skin, short silver-black curls, alert dark eyes, and a composed face that becomes quietly amused when cadets give textbook answers.
C_merin.wardrobe: Academy instructor uniform in deep Fleet blue with restrained gold piping, practical rather than ceremonial, usually carrying a slim archival slate.
C_merin.performance: Uses stillness, short questions, and long silences; rarely lectures when a better question will force the class to expose an assumption.

C_oren.name: Cadet Oren Pell
C_oren.role: Rex Fleet Academy — junior command track; Core-born.
C_oren.voice: Prepared, earnest, inclined to answer in approved formulations before testing them against reality.
C_oren.arc: Learns that correct doctrine can still become dangerous when used as a substitute for judgment.
C_oren.visualAnchor: Young adult man with light olive skin, straight dark hair kept regulation-short, an open serious face, and a habit of sitting too formally.
C_oren.wardrobe: Clean blue-gray Academy cadet uniform with simple rank tabs and a well-used note slate.

C_jo.name: Cadet Jo Ardin
C_jo.role: Rex Fleet Academy — engineering and logistics track; Verge-born.
C_jo.voice: Practical, quick, skeptical of plans that depend on future deliveries or distant authority.
C_jo.arc: Begins by privileging self-sufficiency and gradually sees how isolation can make local competence brittle.
C_jo.visualAnchor: Young adult woman with tan skin, close-cropped dark hair, strong brows, and grease still trapped around one thumbnail despite the classroom setting.
C_jo.wardrobe: Academy cadet uniform worn correctly but without fuss, sleeves often pushed to the regulation limit when working in labs.

C_senn.name: Cadet Senn Tal
C_senn.role: Rex Fleet Academy — diplomacy and civil administration track; Shard-origin.
C_senn.voice: Measured and skeptical; listens for who gets authority when people say they are helping.
C_senn.arc: Tests Fleet doctrine against consent, local legitimacy, and the history of abandonment without reducing every act of Reach to domination.
C_senn.visualAnchor: Young adult nonbinary cadet with dark skin, a narrow thoughtful face, closely braided hair gathered at the back, and a steady assessing gaze.
C_senn.wardrobe: Academy cadet uniform with one small permitted red-thread keepsake braided around the wrist.

C_nadi.name: Cadet Nadi Voss
C_nadi.role: Rex Fleet Academy — navigation and operations track; Fleet-family background.
C_nadi.voice: Operational, calm, continually asks what happens when time, fuel, routes, or people run out.
C_nadi.arc: Pushes abstract arguments back toward clocks, capacity, and consequences.
C_nadi.visualAnchor: Young adult woman with fair skin, dark auburn hair in a compact braid, gray-green eyes, and an attentive posture that angles toward maps and timing displays.
C_nadi.wardrobe: Academy cadet uniform with navigation-track tab and a compact wrist chronometer.

C_ava.name: Ava Seltos
C_ava.voice: Direct, logistical, focused on routes, handoffs, and who actually receives what.
C_ava.visualAnchor: Adult convoy planner in practical post-Break work layers, carrying route packets and physical manifests rather than polished institutional equipment.
promptContinuity: This is the same Ava Seltos established in Shattering of the Corridors.
Her practical convoy methods foreshadow later Verge culture without depicting mature Verge symbols too early.

C_ruben.name: Ruben Markham
C_ruben.role: Outer engineering liaison; progenitor of Shard practical survival ethos.
C_ruben.voice: Blunt, mechanically specific, suspicious of any plan that cannot be repaired locally.
C_ruben.visualAnchor: Adult Outer Band engineer in patched practical work gear, visibly accustomed to salvaged machinery, field repairs, and equipment without guaranteed replacement parts.
promptContinuity: This is the same Ruben Markham established in Shattering of the Corridors.
His survival practice foreshadows later Shard engineering culture without mature Shard uniform design.

C_mira.name: Mira Cale
C_mira.role: Historical case study — Orison habitat coordinator.
C_mira.voice: Competent, exhausted, accustomed to a system in which replacement capacity always arrived from somewhere else.
C_mira.visualAnchor: Adult woman with brown skin, tightly tied black hair, hollowed tired eyes, and a once-formal habitat coordinator jacket now worn over emergency utility layers.
C_mira.performance: Defensive when dependence is named aloud because every request she makes is attached to people who need help now.

C_eshen.name: Eshen Varr
C_eshen.role: Historical case study — Varda maintenance chief and civic delegate.
C_eshen.voice: Controlled, wary, technically competent, unwilling to let outside assistance become outside command.
C_eshen.visualAnchor: Older man with deep-set eyes, weathered pale-brown skin, short white hair, and a heavy locally made maintenance coat repaired many times.
C_eshen.performance: Keeps his body between visitors and local infrastructure until trust is earned through information rather than presence.
